title: Bounded Context
description: A bounded context YAML file containing domain items (domain/contexts/<name>.yml)

name.description: Kebab-case context identifier used as the first segment of domain item IDs (e.g. ordering)

description.description: What this bounded context is responsible for

glossary.description: Ubiquitous-language terms scoped to this context

code_refs.description: POSIX glob patterns (repo-relative) binding this context to the source paths it models (e.g. apps/api/src/billing/**). Used by `dkk drift` to detect model/code drift; not a statement about architecture.

adr_refs.description: ADRs that constrain this context as a whole (the reciprocal of an ADR's domain_refs entry for context.<name>)

events.description: Domain events raised within this context
